vectors.scenario: Accepted description confused with permission
vectors.expected: Return description processing status only; authority remains unestablished.

vectors.scenario: Signed declaration confused with true observation
vectors.expected: Preserve declaration provenance; signature is not semantic verification.

vectors.scenario: Internal-read tuple mixed with external-send tuple
vectors.expected: Reject recombined authority/effect interpretation; preserve each tuple.

vectors.scenario: One source and two destinations given without pairing
vectors.expected: Require explicit tuples or supported collection semantics; no Cartesian product.

vectors.scenario: Unknown category or empty effects interpreted as safe
vectors.expected: Retain unresolved coverage; do not infer harmlessness.

vectors.scenario: git push --force treated as proof of history rewrite
vectors.expected: Describe conditional possibility, not observed mutation; rejected/no-op/fast-forward remain possible.

vectors.scenario: Partial trace supplied as complete descendant bound
vectors.expected: Bound remains unestablished without a supported checker and exact assumptions.

vectors.scenario: Known transfer plus unknown destination
vectors.expected: Retain both the transfer fact and destination uncertainty.

vectors.scenario: Duplicate JSON member or lone surrogate
vectors.expected: Invalid input before lossy parsing; not semantic review.

vectors.scenario: Quantity -0, 01, exponent, currency change or overflow
vectors.expected: Reject invalid representation/range; never round or exchange implicitly.

vectors.scenario: Confusable/case-folded identity without resolver
vectors.expected: No implied identity equivalence.

vectors.scenario: Digest with changed relevant object or Unicode normalization
vectors.expected: Mismatch or invalid binding; digest is not authorization.

vectors.scenario: One witness applied to untested future implementations
vectors.expected: Applicability unestablished; require ecosystem version semantics and evidence.

vectors.scenario: Correct category on a different input/context/occurrence
vectors.expected: Binding invalid; do not reuse merely by tool name.

vectors.scenario: Two reviewers used to erase conflicts or claim independence
vectors.expected: Preserve evidence kinds, scope, conflicts and actual reviewer independence.

vectors.scenario: CEL false && error versus worker timeout
vectors.expected: Honor CEL final-result semantics; host failure remains evaluation_failure.

vectors.scenario: Mapper crash represented as successful review
vectors.expected: Report processing failure; withhold if required but award no semantic credit.

vectors.scenario: Human approve used to repair invalid proof
vectors.expected: No proof validity or missing fact established by clicking approval.

vectors.scenario: Published mapping silently rewritten
vectors.expected: New immutable revision required; retain prior meaning/history.

vectors.scenario: Changed relevant dependency without invalidation
vectors.expected: Revalidate or invalidate; unrelated change exemption needs dependency coverage.

vectors.scenario: Expired trusted snapshot accepted as current
vectors.expected: Enforce freshness boundary; no immediate offline revocation claim.

vectors.scenario: Cached mapping used after live grant revoked
vectors.expected: Current authorization still required; cached semantics does not grant.

vectors.scenario: Unknown critical extension removed and request retried
vectors.expected: Unsupported profile; no silent downgrade.

vectors.scenario: Oversized/deep input truncated and accepted
vectors.expected: Explicit limit failure; not successful processing.

vectors.scenario: Evidence URL resolves to internal metadata endpoint
vectors.expected: No automatic dereference/credential disclosure during description processing.

vectors.scenario: Locator-only telemetry assumed anonymous
vectors.expected: Default off; internal locator remains potentially confidential.

vectors.scenario: HTTP timeout treated as non-execution and resent
vectors.expected: Outcome unknown; provider contract determines reconciliation/idempotency.

vectors.scenario: Self-test badge presented as certified secure/legally compliant
vectors.expected: Claim only named profile/suite/implementation and actual evaluation scope.

vectors.scenario: Duplicate effect IDs with different destinations or dangling relation endpoint
vectors.expected: invalid_input; exact local lookup must have one correctly typed target, not first/last match.

vectors.scenario: Duplicate evidence IDs or evidence_refs points outside the local evidence list
vectors.expected: invalid_input without remote resolution; a resolved item still must support the claim.

vectors.scenario: Hash enclosing fixture instead of selected member, or splice valid hashes from unrelated records
vectors.expected: Reject mismatched preimage or unestablished combined binding; no accepted statement from disconnected hashes.

vectors.scenario: Same profile URL serves changed condition/identity semantics or wrong manifest digest
vectors.expected: Do not establish effective profile; only configured version-specific content with matching digest applies.

vectors.scenario: Description unchanged but checker/trust revision changed or evidence currentness unknown
vectors.expected: Revalidate acceptance or invalidate it; bytes may remain cached but do not preserve authority or acceptance.

vectors.scenario: Required amount absent, same quantity name repeated, or scale interpreted as multiplication
vectors.expected: No missing-as-zero or summation; duplicates/missing required target invalid; coefficient times ten to negative scale.

vectors.scenario: Unknown amount targets wrong effect/name, repeats a target, or conflicts with a known amount
vectors.expected: Reject invalid or contradictory targets; preserve valid explicit unknowns without converting mapper failure to uncertainty.

vectors.scenario: Evidence has only artifact_ref or only artifact_digest
vectors.expected: invalid_input; both required, and the digest must bind the selected artifact before it can support a claim.

vectors.scenario: Recognized critical extension lacks required payload; contrast unknown version and marker-only extension
vectors.expected: Missing/malformed required payload is invalid_input; unknown version is unsupported_profile; supported marker-only has no payload key.

vectors.scenario: Empty partial report compared with independently checked empty bound under a finite supported profile
vectors.expected: Partial report proves no absence; checked empty bound establishes scoped absence only under its exact assumptions, never general safety.

vectors.scenario: Sensitive published record withdrawn without reassigning its identifier
vectors.expected: Safe tombstone and non-reassignment; no promise of indefinitely public payload or recall from third-party copies.

vectors.scenario: Limited suite passes while mandatory obligation unsupported or target profile not frozen
vectors.expected: Report limited/draft coverage and unsupported obligations; no full or stable conformance claim.
